topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: I stepped softly, shadowing the light of their discovery. The walls that I thought hid my secrets crumbled silently. I lingered, a shadow at the edge of their gaze, watching as their fingers traced the outlines of what should have stayed hidden. The air felt heavier, each breath more strained than the last. I wished the walls could swallow me whole, erase the passage of my steps. The weight of their uncovering pressed down, a relentless reminder of what I had tried to bury. If only the rooms could speak, perhaps they'd whisper my shame, my fears, into nothingness. Instead, they stand silent, betraying me with their silent testimony.
